text:
Mia: FYI EU S3 had a brief spike, kafka commits lagged. ~36h of late telemetry. Thinking staged reprocess instead of blasting shards.
Omar: +1 staged. last time we blew budget. hot-window + sampled warm window.
Leah: Console must show dry-run cost estimates before launch. Ops keep starting blind.
Tess: dedupe-pass first? skip keys where aggregate_ts >= event_ingest_time. cheap and effective.
Ryan: runner should include origin tag (origin=s3-eu-3167) and backfill-id header so traces/billing link.
sre-bot: alert resolved: ingest-eu-s3-3167700000 ~30m ago.
Mia: proposal: hot=last12h full atomic commit (canary 1% tenants), warm=12-72h 10% deterministic sample, cold>72h skip. add per-tenant cap for warm slots.
Omar: deterministic selector: hash(tenant||hour||seed) % 100 < 10. include seed in YAML.
Tess: sample SQL prototype: SELECT tenant_id,hour FROM telemetry_index WHERE hour > now()-interval '72 hours' AND (abs(hash_text(concat(tenant_id,hour,'seed'))) % 100) < 10
Leah: dry-run should return estimate_cpu_hours, estimate_rows_touched, est_s3_gb, est_cost_usd and allow "auto-abort if cost > $X". Show optimistic/pessimistic (with/without dedupe).
Ryan: hot atomic via staging-table swap; warm partial commits so ops can abort mid-sweep. I'll add origin_tag + staging swap. ETA EOD.
Mia: I'll wire Console dry-run + one-click template. Draft YAML: replay_policy: staged_v1, hot_window:12h, warm_window:72h, sample_pct:10, max_slots_per_tenant:2, trace_header: x-replay-id
Omar: LGTM. Tag me on PR for cost calc review.
Leah: I'll add UX copy + warning banner for EU late-ingest.
Mia: plan: dry-run -> canary hot on 1% tenants -> validate -> run hot full -> start warm sampled sweep. Ping #eng-sre on blockers.
